pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi ‘prakrtanupayuktoktirarTantaraniti sTiti’ iti karikanusarenarTantaran laksayati prakrteti aDikye ativyaptipariharaya prakrtanupayukteti visesanan aparTakavyavrtaye anviteti visesanan draswavyan kunqan ajajinan ityadivat ananvitan na BavatityarTa svapareti svanatariti paranatariti uBayanatariti anuBayanataritisceti Bedat ityarTa dravyan srotretyadO ‘sabdonitya’ ityanuvartate ganDadiBiriti akase ganDarasadinan vadiprativadiByananangikarena sabde tatsananaDi-karanyaBavat iti Bava nanu ‘sabdonitya, sa cakasavisesaguna’ ityadO hetvadyanaBiDanena nyunataderapi sanBavat tasyEvodBavyatvopapatO kin arTantarena ? ityata aha atreti arTantarodaharanasTala ityarTa tasya nyunatade uktagrahyatvaditi ukte sati uktyanantaraniti yavat grahyatvat udBavyatvat ityarTa asya ceti arTantarasya cetyarTa ucyananagrahyatveneti ucyananadasodBavyatvat ityarTa yaTahu: ‘uktagrahya kecidanyenuktagrahyastaTa pare ucyananadasagrahya iti kalastriDa nata’ iti praTanapraptatvat purasPurtikatvat 6
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti ‘prakrtanupayuktoktirartantaraniti stiti’ iti karikanusarenartantaran laksayati prakrteti atikye ativyaptipariharaya prakrtanupayukteti visesanan apartakavyavrtaye anviteti visesanan trastavyan kuntan acacinan ityativat ananvitan na pavatityarta svapareti svanatariti paranatariti upayanatariti anupayanataritisceti petat ityarta travyan srotretyatO ‘saptonitya’ ityanuvartate kantatipiriti akase kantarasatinan vatiprativatipyananankikarena sapte tatsananati-karanyapavat iti pava nanu ‘saptonitya, sa cakasavisesakuna’ ityatO hetvatyanapitanena nyunataterapi sanpavat tasyEvotpavyatvopapatO kin artantarena ? ityata aha atreti artantarotaharanastala ityarta tasya nyunatate uktakrahyatvatiti ukte sati uktyanantaraniti yavat krahyatvat utpavyatvat ityarta asya ceti artantarasya cetyarta ucyananakrahyatveneti ucyananatasotpavyatvat ityarta yatahu: ‘uktakrahya kecitanyenuktakrahyastata pare ucyananatasakrahya iti kalastrita nata’ iti pratanapraptatvat puraspurtikatvat 6

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi ‘avacakaprayoge syanirarTakasanudBava’ iti karikanusarena nirarTakan laksayati aboDakasabdeti natrkapaWeti aksarapaWetyarTa kaTanciditi tatvapratipatilingatvarupanigrahasTanalaksana-BavadityarTa na hiti kin tu ? sanyajnapakatvaneva tatu kacawatapetinatrka-paWalingaviparyasadiBirna Bavatyeveti tatvapratipatilingatvat yuktan nigraha-sTanatvaniti Bava nanu kaTancijnapakatvasya sabdaDarnatvaBave kaTancijnananapi tatra kaTan Bavati ? ityata aha prakaranadinEveti na tu sabdenetyarTa nanu Basantarasankarasya nigrahasTanatve vadiprativadino parasparan BasaBi-jnayoryatra ‘svasvaBasayEva kaTaniyan’ iti sanayabanDena kaTapravrtistatrapi nigrahasTanan syat ityata aha Basantarasankaropiti sanasanaya ‘svasvaBasayEva kaTaniyan’ iti sanketabanDa sanasanayatvadasayan tu na nigrahasTanatvaniti Bava anyaTeti sanasanayatvaBavadasayanapi nigrahasTanatvanangikara ityarTa sanasanayatvaBavadasayaniti sesa tadanaBijnasya tadiyaBasanaBijnasya prativadina utaraBavaprasangaditi tadananijna ‘tvaya Basantara-sankarakaranat nana tadajnanat tava nirarTakan nana nigrahasTanan’ iti utaran vadati tana syat ityarTa taTa ca sanasanayatvaBave nigrahasTanan Bavatyeveti Bava 7
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti ‘avacakaprayoke syanirartakasanutpava’ iti karikanusarena nirartakan laksayati apotakasapteti natrkapateti aksarapatetyarta katancititi tatvapratipatilinkatvarupanikrahastanalaksana-pavatityarta na hiti kin tu ? sanyacnapakatvaneva tatu kacatatapetinatrka-patalinkaviparyasatipirna pavatyeveti tatvapratipatilinkatvat yuktan nikraha-stanatvaniti pava nanu katancicnapakatvasya saptatarnatvapave katancicnananapi tatra katan pavati ? ityata aha prakaranatinEveti na tu saptenetyarta nanu pasantarasankarasya nikrahastanatve vatiprativatino parasparan pasapi-cnayoryatra ‘svasvapasayEva kataniyan’ iti sanayapantena katapravrtistatrapi nikrahastanan syat ityata aha pasantarasankaropiti sanasanaya ‘svasvapasayEva kataniyan’ iti sanketapanta sanasanayatvatasayan tu na nikrahastanatvaniti pava anyateti sanasanayatvapavatasayanapi nikrahastanatvanankikara ityarta sanasanayatvapavatasayaniti sesa tatanapicnasya tatiyapasanapicnasya prativatina utarapavaprasankatiti tatananicna ‘tvaya pasantara-sankarakaranat nana tatacnanat tava nirartakan nana nikrahastanan’ iti utaran vatati tana syat ityarta tata ca sanasanayatvapave nikrahastanan pavatyeveti pava 7

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi ‘anvitasyopayuktasya punaruktetarasya ca krtakaryakarasyoktiraDikan tatpracaksate’ iti karikanusarenaDikan laksayati anviteti atraparTakarTantara-punaruktasaduktipariharaya kranena visesanani draswavyani hetudaharanetyadO dvandvante sruyananaDikyapadasya pratyekan sanbanDo draswavya nanu pratijnaDikyan nigananaDikyan catra kuto na grhitan ? iti cet atra praswavyan , yatra pratijnaDikyan nigananaDikyan vocyate tatra ‘parvatogninan, parvatogninan’ ityevan pratijnayo ‘tasnadagninaneva, tasnadagninaneva , ityevan nigananayosca ekarTatvan vivaksitan ? uta BinarTatvan ? dvitiyepi tat kin kincit prakrtasangatan ? uta sarvaTa prakrtasangatan ? iti vikalpan hrdi niDaya adya aha pratijnetyadi dvitiye adya aha anyarTatva iti prakrtasangataviti ‘sabdonitya praneyatvat iti hetu hetusabdasca hinoterDato’ ityadivat kincit prakrtasangatavityarTa dvitiye dvitiya aha asangataviti sarvaTa prakrtasangatO ‘kunqan ajajinan dasa daqinani’ ityadivat aparTakanityarTa etat hetvaDikyan pancaviDanapi yaTakranan viDadvayena pratyekanudaharati tatradyan yaTetyadina visesata kanWata , vacakasabdenopadananiti yavat sananyata sananyakarena adipadeneti yavat adyan hetvaDikyan aloketi visesato hetvaDikyan nidarsitan alokasananyasya vahnacananunapakatvat visesapadan Dnavatvaderiti sananyato hetvaDikyan nidarsitan evanutaratrapi draswavyan 12
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti ‘anvitasyopayuktasya punaruktetarasya ca krtakaryakarasyoktiratikan tatpracaksate’ iti karikanusarenatikan laksayati anviteti atrapartakartantara-punaruktasatuktipariharaya kranena visesanani trastavyani hetutaharanetyatO tvantvante sruyananatikyapatasya pratyekan sanpanto trastavya nanu praticnatikyan nikananatikyan catra kuto na krhitan ? iti cet atra prastavyan , yatra praticnatikyan nikananatikyan vocyate tatra ‘parvatokninan, parvatokninan’ ityevan praticnayo ‘tasnatakninaneva, tasnatakninaneva , ityevan nikananayosca ekartatvan vivaksitan ? uta pinartatvan ? tvitiyepi tat kin kincit prakrtasankatan ? uta sarvata prakrtasankatan ? iti vikalpan hrti nitaya atya aha praticnetyati tvitiye atya aha anyartatva iti prakrtasankataviti ‘saptonitya praneyatvat iti hetu hetusaptasca hinotertato’ ityativat kincit prakrtasankatavityarta tvitiye tvitiya aha asankataviti sarvata prakrtasankatO ‘kuntan acacinan tasa tatinani’ ityativat apartakanityarta etat hetvatikyan pancavitanapi yatakranan vitatvayena pratyekanutaharati tatratyan yatetyatina visesata kantata , vacakasaptenopatananiti yavat sananyata sananyakarena atipateneti yavat atyan hetvatikyan aloketi visesato hetvatikyan nitarsitan alokasananyasya vahnacananunapakatvat visesapatan tnavatvateriti sananyato hetvatikyan nitarsitan evanutaratrapi trastavyan 12

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi ‘jnatarTan prasnikErvakyan triruktan nanuBasate yonudBavya svanajnanan tasyEvananuBasanan’ iti karikanusarenananuBasanan laksayati vadinoktasyeti prasnikErityanenavijnatarTavyavacCeda parisada prasnikena vadineti parisadeti ucaraneti ca dosatvopapadanaya svarupakaTanan , na vyavartakan svajnananana-viskurvata ityanena ajnanavyavacCeda tatrajnanaviskaranasya vaksyananatvat kaTanavicCindata ityanena viksepavyavacCeda iti jnatavyan avicCindata prativadina iti sesa tatpancaviDaniti yatadityadyanuvadadicaturnan apratyucaranaprati-niDitvat ananuBasanatvaneveti jnatavyan sarvancEtaditi pancaviDanapyananu-BasananityarTa pratyutaradanasya catursu sanatvat ananuBasanatvan apratyucaranan hi yogyotaradanaBava eva kuta ? ityato nigrahasTanasananyalaksanayogat ityaBipretya vyutkranenopa-padayati tusninBava ityadina dusanadyapratiteriti taTa ca tusninBavasya apratipatijnapakatvat nigrahasTanatvanityarTa adusakatvat parapaksadusanasanarTatvat ityarTa taTa ca dusanasanarTe dusanasanarTyapratipatirupa-vipratipatisucakatvat dusananatrasya nigrahasTanatvanityasaya anyaTanuvada iti vyaDikaranasyadusanatvena adusane dusanatva-budDirupavipratipatisucakatvat nigrahasTanatvanityarTa visiswadusanaditi ‘sabdonityo gunatve satyEndriyakatvat’ iti visiswe hetO vadinoktepi ‘Endriyakatvat’ iti heturayukta sananye vyaBicarat iti yada prativadi brte tada gunatvavisiswahetoradusanepi ekadesadusanenavisiswopi dusito Bavatiti virudDarTajnanarupavipratipatisucakatvat nigrahasTanatvanevetyarTa ananuvadavisesaditi tusninBavavisesat ityarTa taTa ca dusyavisesasidDyarTananuvadasyavasyakatvena yat tat ityadisananyanuvadasya nanuvadavisesena tusninBavarupataya apratipatijnapakatvat nigrahasTanatva-nevetyasaya dusyavisesasidDyarTananuvadasyavasyakatvaniti yat uktan tana yat tat ityadyanuvadan krtva tanakrtva va vyaBicaraKyadosodBavane tadsanasvarupa-yogyatvena hetureva dusyataya ayasyati ityasankya niseDati na ceti sandigDatvadineti vadyuktapratijnahetudrswantarupadO visvasaBavena sandigDataya sarvasyapi dusyatvena prativadina ‘vyaBicara , ityuktepi ‘kinayan vyaBicarena pratijnan dusayati hetvadikan va’ iti sandeha eva vadino Bavisyatiti na dusanasvarupayogyatvena hetoreva sidDirityanuvada avasyaka iti Bava nanu na hyevan prativadi nurKo yena vyaBicaraKyadosena pratijnan dusayet tasnat anuvadaBavepi tadyogyatvena heturevayasyatiti tadarTan nanuvada avasyaka ityata aha yogyaneveti prananabaDitanevetyarTa taTa ca prativadinyaptatva-niscayaBavena pranadaderapi sanBavat ‘
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti ‘cnatartan prasnikErvakyan triruktan nanupasate yonutpavya svanacnanan tasyEvananupasanan’ iti karikanusarenananupasanan laksayati vatinoktasyeti prasnikErityanenavicnatartavyavaceta parisata prasnikena vatineti parisateti ucaraneti ca tosatvopapatanaya svarupakatanan , na vyavartakan svacnananana-viskurvata ityanena acnanavyavaceta tatracnanaviskaranasya vaksyananatvat katanavicintata ityanena viksepavyavaceta iti cnatavyan avicintata prativatina iti sesa tatpancavitaniti yatatityatyanuvataticaturnan apratyucaranaprati-nititvat ananupasanatvaneveti cnatavyan sarvancEtatiti pancavitanapyananu-pasananityarta pratyutaratanasya catursu sanatvat ananupasanatvan apratyucaranan hi yokyotaratanapava eva kuta ? pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi ‘aniswaBranatonyesaniswanapadayedyadi natanujneti tasya syanigrahasTananutkawan’ itikarikanusarena natanujnan laksayati aniswaBraneneti iswasyapadana-yogenasanBava syat ata uktan aniswaBraneneti tata eva purusatvahetubaladeva asyeswapadanatvopapadanayEva svasya coratvanaByupaganya ityuktan purusatvaheto svatnani vyaBicarapariharayEtaduktan ityapyahu nanvapratipatyadihetutvaBavat kaTanidan nigrahasTanan ? ityata aha na hyaneneti tavapi coratvaprasanga ityapadanenetyarTa taTa ca svasya coratveparihrtepi parihrtaniti virudDarTa-pratipatirupavipratipatisucakatvanigrahasTanan Bavatyeveti Bava prakarantarena vipratipatihetutvanupapadayati napiti prasanga apadanan sanicina iti sesa kuto na ? ityata aha iswapatiti ‘tarkoniswaprasanga syat’ ityuktatvenatra tadaBavadityarTa taTa caniswaBranarupavipratipatisucakatva-cedan nigrahasTanan iti Bava 18

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi anutpane saDanange hetuvrteraBavata BagasidDiprasanga syadanutpatisano nata itikarikanusarena anutpatisanajaterlaksananaha paksadinaniti adipadena lingasaDyadrswantanan grahanan sadutare asidDyudBavane ativyaptivaranaya paksadinanutpate pragityuktan asrayaBageti utpanatvavasTayan heto satvepi anutpanatva-vasTayanaBavat anutpanasrayaBage asidDirityarTa ityaditi linganutpatO yaTa ‘idan guru patanavatvat’ ityukte patanotpate pragavasTayanapi gurutvasya saDyatvena tadavasTasyapi paksatvat BagasidDo heturiti, saDyanutpatO yaTa ‘Gawo ganDavan parTivatvat’ ityukte praTanaksane ganDavatvarupavyapakaBavat vyapyasya parTivatvasyapyaBavapatya BagasidDo heturiti, drswantanutpatO yaTa ‘atnadravyan gunavatvat Gawavat’ ityukte praTanaksane Gawa eva nirguna iti drswante BagasidDo heturiti draswavyan anutpanasya paksade svakaryasanarTyaBinana iti svakaryasanarTyan saDanangatvarupan tadaBinana ityarTa ata evoktan ‘parvatasyotpate pragapi paksatvat’ iti svakaryasanarTyeti paWastu vicaryarTaka anutpanasya yat svakaryasanarTyan tat vastavaneva na tvaBinanikan ato nasyotTanabijatvan yuktaniti asidDyadityadipadena viroDo grahya ‘viroDasidDi aropye’ iti varada-rajiyokte anutpanasya saDanangataya pratyaksadivirudDatvadityarTa jatyutarepiti ‘Dunavatvat iti hetu na saDyasaDaka BagasidDatvat’ iti jatyutarepi paksiButasya Dunavatvaditi heto utpate pragapi paksatvat anutpane tasnin BagasidDatvaKyaheto avrte asrayaBage asidDi iti vaktun sakyatvat svanyayaviroDa ityarTa anutpanasyeti anupanasya paksade saDanangataya ayuktaya eva svikarat ayuktangaDikatvanityarTa dvitiyadipadena avisayavrtitvasangraha praTanadipadena tadupapadakasangraha taTa hi, hetuvrte utpana eva pakso visayo na tvanutpanopi taTa ca nutpanasya parvatatvaBavena apaksataya visayatvaBavat tatra hetuvrtyangikarat avisayavrtitvaniti Bava 12 Endragnent
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti anutpane satananke hetuvrterapavata pakasitiprasanka syatanutpatisano nata itikarikanusarena anutpatisanacaterlaksananaha paksatinaniti atipatena linkasatyatrstantanan krahanan satutare asityutpavane ativyaptivaranaya paksatinanutpate prakityuktan asrayapaketi utpanatvavastayan heto satvepi anutpanatva-vastayanapavat anutpanasrayapake asitirityarta ityatiti linkanutpatO yata ‘itan kuru patanavatvat’ ityukte patanotpate prakavastayanapi kurutvasya satyatvena tatavastasyapi paksatvat pakasito heturiti, satyanutpatO yata ‘kato kantavan partivatvat’ ityukte pratanaksane kantavatvarupavyapakapavat vyapyasya partivatvasyapyapavapatya pakasito heturiti, trstantanutpatO yata ‘atnatravyan kunavatvat katavat’ ityukte pratanaksane kata eva nirkuna iti trstante pakasito heturiti trastavyan anutpanasya paksate svakaryasanartyapinana iti svakaryasanartyan satanankatvarupan tatapinana ityarta ata evoktan ‘parvatasyotpate prakapi paksatvat’ iti svakaryasanartyeti patastu vicaryartaka anutpanasya yat svakaryasanartyan tat vastavaneva na tvapinanikan ato nasyotanapicatvan yuktaniti asityatityatipatena viroto krahya ‘virotasiti aropye’ iti varata-raciyokte anutpanasya satanankataya pratyaksativirutatvatityarta catyutarepiti ‘tunavatvat iti hetu na satyasataka pakasitatvat’ iti catyutarepi paksiputasya tunavatvatiti heto utpate prakapi paksatvat anutpane tasnin pakasitatvakyaheto avrte asrayapake asiti iti vaktun sakyatvat svanyayavirota ityarta anutpanasyeti anupanasya paksate satanankataya ayuktaya eva svikarat ayuktankatikatvanityarta tvitiyatipatena avisayavrtitvasankraha pratanatipatena tatupapatakasankraha tata hi, hetuvrte utpana eva pakso visayo na tvanutpanopi tata ca nutpanasya parvatatvapavena apaksataya visayatvapavat tatra hetuvrtyankikarat avisayavrtitvaniti pava 12 Entraknent

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi sandehahetusadBavatsati nirnayakarane sansayasya prasango ya sa sansayasano Bavet itikarikanusarena sansayasanajatin laksayati satyapiti nirnayakarane visesadarsane sansayakarananatreneti sananaDarnadirupasansayakarananatrene-tyarTa atra visesadarsanasahakrtasananaDarnadina sansayapadanarupe sadutare ativyapti syat tatpariharaya natrapadan visesadarsanasahakrtatvan natrasabdarTa ityasayena tadvivaranaya satyapi nirnayakarana ityuktaniti jnatavyan sananaDarnanatradarsanan sansayakarananiti sesa ityaBinana sanbanDa tadrahitasyEveti nirnayakasyeti sesa sananaDarnarahitasyEvetyarTa na tu visesadarsanasahakrtasyeti evarTa nirnayeti nirnaya karanan visesadarsanan tadrahityasya visesadarsanasyeti yavat anangikarat yuktangahaniriti sanbanDa sansayakaranan sananaDarnadi tadrahityanatrasyetyarTa anangikaradayuktanga-Dikatvaniti sanbanDa anyaTeti nirnayakaBavasahakrtasyEva sananaDarnade sansayakaranatvat atra ca nirnayakasadBavat na sansaya ityanangikare pratyuta nirnayakan na sansayapratibanDakanityangikare cetyarTa dusakadusakasaDarnyan padarTatvaditi jatavapiti taTa ca ‘Dunavatvat’ iti hetu saDyasaDaka satpratipaksatvat’ iti jatyutarepi ‘yadi satpratipaksatvat saDyasaDakatvaniscaya ? tarhi dusakadusakasaDaranena padarTatvadina asaDakatvasansayopi kin na syat’ iti sansayaprasangasanyat svanyayaviroDa ityarTa 13
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti santehahetusatpavatsati nirnayakarane sansayasya prasanko ya sa sansayasano pavet itikarikanusarena sansayasanacatin laksayati satyapiti nirnayakarane visesatarsane sansayakarananatreneti sananatarnatirupasansayakarananatrene-tyarta atra visesatarsanasahakrtasananatarnatina sansayapatanarupe satutare ativyapti syat tatpariharaya natrapatan visesatarsanasahakrtatvan natrasaptarta ityasayena tatvivaranaya satyapi nirnayakarana ityuktaniti cnatavyan sananatarnanatratarsanan sansayakarananiti sesa ityapinana sanpanta tatrahitasyEveti nirnayakasyeti sesa sananatarnarahitasyEvetyarta na tu visesatarsanasahakrtasyeti evarta nirnayeti nirnaya karanan visesatarsanan tatrahityasya visesatarsanasyeti yavat anankikarat yuktankahaniriti sanpanta sansayakaranan sananatarnati tatrahityanatrasyetyarta anankikaratayuktanka-tikatvaniti sanpanta anyateti nirnayakapavasahakrtasyEva sananatarnate sansayakaranatvat atra ca nirnayakasatpavat na sansaya ityanankikare pratyuta nirnayakan na sansayapratipantakanityankikare cetyarta tusakatusakasatarnyan patartatvatiti catavapiti tata ca ‘tunavatvat’ iti hetu satyasataka satpratipaksatvat’ iti catyutarepi ‘yati satpratipaksatvat satyasatakatvaniscaya ? tarhi tusakatusakasataranena patartatvatina asatakatvasansayopi kin na syat’ iti sansayaprasankasanyat svanyayavirota ityarta 13

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi tulyatvanaByupetyEva paraheto svahetuna baDena pratyavasTanan prakriyasana isyate itikarikanusarena prakaranasanajaterlaksananaha angikrteti yaTetyanantaran ‘Dunavatvat parvatogninan’ iti sTapanahetO prayukta iti sesa sTapanaya sTapanayuktya jateriti agnipratiseDahetordravyatvasya sTapanahetubaDakatvopayogina tadapeksaya aDikabalavatvasyaBavepi tadbaDakatvoktO sTapanahetunEva jate pratiseDahetorbaDaprapte svanyayaviroDa na ca pratiseDahetvapeksaya sTapanahetoraDikabalavatvaBavat kaTan tena pratiseDahetorbaDaprapti ? iti vacyan baDakatvena aDikabalavatvasya tvaya tantratanangikaraditi Bava 14
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti tulyatvanapyupetyEva paraheto svahetuna patena pratyavastanan prakriyasana isyate itikarikanusarena prakaranasanacaterlaksananaha ankikrteti yatetyanantaran ‘tunavatvat parvatokninan’ iti stapanahetO prayukta iti sesa stapanaya stapanayuktya cateriti aknipratisetahetortravyatvasya stapanahetupatakatvopayokina tatapeksaya atikapalavatvasyapavepi tatpatakatvoktO stapanahetunEva cate pratisetahetorpataprapte svanyayavirota na ca pratisetahetvapeksaya stapanahetoratikapalavatvapavat katan tena pratisetahetorpataprapti ? iti vacyan patakatvena atikapalavatvasya tvaya tantratanankikaratiti pava 14

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi hetorvikaplya saDyarTapurvaparasahodayan treDapi tasya hetutvaBangohetusano Bavet itikarikanusarena otusanajatin laksayati hetoriti krtijnaptisaDa-raniyan jati Bavasabdasya purvaparasabdaByanapi sanbanDo draswavya agninatva-jnanaditi krtipaksaBiprayena agninatvadveti jnaptipaksaBiprayeneti nantavyan tasya Dunavatvajnanasya saDanatvayogaditi saDyan saDyate aneneti sadDyasidDikaranatvarupasaDanatvasya saDyanirupyatvena purva saDyaBave kina-peksayedan saDanan syaditi saDanatvayogadityarTa tatvayogaditi saDana-Bavepi jayananasya saDanajanyasidDikarnatvarupan saDanatvan na yuktan taTa ca purvasidDan yat saDyan tat prati kaTanidan saDanan syat ? ityarTa

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi vyapte vina vadivakyadarTaksepaBinanata viparitasanaropanarTapatisanan bidu itikarakianusarena arTapatisanajatin laksayati vyaptin vineti ityaditi adisabdarTastu ‘anityaptaDarnyat sabdonitya’ ityukte arTat apanan ‘nityaptaDarnyanitya’ iti taTa ca pratiroDa ityadina varadajatiyokto draswavya saDyavikalatvadityatra adipadena pratiroDadigrahanan etaTa ca drswantaBava iti paksatirikte sarvatra arTat saDakatvasya labDatvena asaDakatve drswantaBavena tatra saDyasyapi sutaranaBavatsaDyavEkalyaniti svanyayaviroDa ityarTa 16

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi DarnenEkena kesancidavisesaprasanjanan saDanapratibandya yatsovisesasano nata itikarikanusarena avisesasanajatin laksayati saDanapratibandyeti taditaraDarneneti vadisaDanavyatiriktaDarnenetyarTa utkarsasanavyavacCedayedan visesananiti nantavyan kasyacidityadi dravyatvasya sarvadravyanityatva-saDakatvadarsanan jatyutarotTanabijanityarTa anyaTeti vyaptyadyanangikara ityarTa asya Dunanunanasya sanpratipanasyeti tarkaparahatataya asaDakatvena sanpratipanasya kasyacidityarTa tarketi ‘dravyatvat sarvadravyanananityatvan syat’ iti tarkaparahata-tvenetyarTa taTa ca ‘Dunanunanasya sanpratipanakincidanunanasya cetyuBayo tarkaparahatatvena yadi asaDakatvavisesa tarhi padarTatvat sarvapadarTanan nityatvenapi visesa syat iti svanyayaviroDa na catra vyaptyaBava tvaya purvan tadangatvanangikaradityarTa 17 Endragnent
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti tarnenEkena kesancitavisesaprasancanan satanapratipantya yatsovisesasano nata itikarikanusarena avisesasanacatin laksayati satanapratipantyeti tatitaratarneneti vatisatanavyatiriktatarnenetyarta utkarsasanavyavacetayetan visesananiti nantavyan kasyacitityati travyatvasya sarvatravyanityatva-satakatvatarsanan catyutarotanapicanityarta anyateti vyaptyatyanankikara ityarta asya tunanunanasya sanpratipanasyeti tarkaparahatataya asatakatvena sanpratipanasya kasyacitityarta tarketi ‘travyatvat sarvatravyanananityatvan syat’ iti tarkaparahata-tvenetyarta tata ca ‘tunanunanasya sanpratipanakincitanunanasya cetyupayo tarkaparahatatvena yati asatakatvavisesa tarhi patartatvat sarvapatartanan nityatvenapi visesa syat iti svanyayavirota na catra vyaptyapava tvaya purvan tatankatvanankikaratityarta 17 Entraknent

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi asnatpaksepi kinapi pranananupapatsyate tvatpaksavaditi praptirupapatisano nata itikarikanusarena upapatisanajatin laksayati natpaksepiti baDa ityadi natpaksiyaprananasya prabalatve tadvirudDasya tvatpaksasya baDa sanabalatve tu pratiroDa ityarTa tasyapiti natpaksepi kincit prananan Bavisyatiti sananyata upanyastasyaprityarTa nirvaktunitipaWe nitaran vaktunityarTa yuktangahaninupapadayati upanyastan pratiti upanyastaprananan pratityarTa anupanyastasyeti kincidBavisyatiti sananyenEvopanyasepi kanWatonupanyastasya prananasyetyarTa prabalyaderityadipadena sanabalatvagrahanan baDadityadipadena pratiroDagrahanan baDadyangasya prabalyaderiti sanbanDa aniscayaditi niscayena nirupanasanBavadityarTa yaToktan varadarajiye ‘anupanyastaprananasya prabalyasanyayornirupanasanBavat’ iti 18

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi avaDaranatatparyan vadivakye vikalpya yat tadbaDatpratyavasTananupalabDisano nata itikarikanusarena upalabDisanajaterlaksananaha vadivakyasyeti parvata eveti asya evakarasya visesyasangatatvat tasya ca visesyatavacCedakanakrante visesanasanbandavyavacCedorTa iti draswavyan parvatogninaneveti asya ca evakarasya visesanasangatatvat tasya ca itarapadarTatavacCedake evakarasanaBi-vyahrtapadarTatavacCedakavyapyatvanarTa ityavaDeyan kadacidanagninatvaditi agnin vinapi kadacit parvatasyopalaBya-nanatvena saDyaBavepi DarnyupalabDerbaDa ityarTa ityaditi adipadena tasyaneva pratijnayan Dunavatvat ityukte Duna kin Darnina anyayogavyavacCedena parvate sanbaDyate ? uta ayogavyavacCedena ? na praTana vrksaderapi upalabDe na dvitiya DunaBavepi kadacit parvatasyopalabDe tatasca saDanaBavepi Darni upalaByata iti asidDi ityadi grahyan baDaditi adipadena asidDigrahanan jatyutarepiti ayan Bava , ‘Dunavatvat iti hetu saDyasaDaka baDitatvat’ iti pratiseDanunanepi kin paksiButo Drnavatvahetureva saDyasaDaka ? uta saDyasaDaka eva ? iti na praTana praneyatvaderapi bahnyasaDakatvadarsanat na dvitiya Dunavatvaheto vahnirupasaDyasaDakatvepi aBiDeyatvarupasaDya-saDakatvadarsanat baDa ityevan avaDarane tatparyanaropya vikalpadusanayo sanyat svanyayaviroDa iti kaTan ? ityata aha anyayogayogavyavacCedasyeti anyayogayogayo-rvyavacCedasyetyarTa ‘ekasatvedvayaniha nasti’ iti pratitisidDavyasajyavrti-pratiyogikaBavaBiprayenedan iha ca anyayogavyavacCedasya ayuktatvepi ayogavyavacCedasya angikarat uBayan vihaya vakyarTayogat na ca ayogavyavacCedangi kare uktadosa iti vacyan idanin vahninatvasya saDyatvena tadayogavyavacCedopapate iti ata eva ‘tasnadvahninaneva’ iti niganananiti sanpradaya uktan ca varadarajiye ‘ayogavyavacCedanatrena avaDaranopapatO’ iti taTa ca ayogavyavacCedanatrena avaDaranopapatO anyayogavyavacCedena avaDaranasya ayuktasyEva tvaya angikarat ayuktangaDikatvan iti Bava 19
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti avataranatatparyan vativakye vikalpya yat tatpatatpratyavastananupalaptisano nata itikarikanusarena upalaptisanacaterlaksananaha vativakyasyeti parvata eveti asya evakarasya visesyasankatatvat tasya ca visesyatavacetakanakrante visesanasanpantavyavacetorta iti trastavyan parvatokninaneveti asya ca evakarasya visesanasankatatvat tasya ca itarapatartatavacetake evakarasanapi-vyahrtapatartatavacetakavyapyatvanarta ityavateyan katacitanakninatvatiti aknin vinapi katacit parvatasyopalapya-nanatvena satyapavepi tarnyupalapterpata ityarta ityatiti atipatena tasyaneva praticnayan tunavatvat ityukte tuna kin tarnina anyayokavyavacetena parvate sanpatyate ? uta ayokavyavacetena ? na pratana vrksaterapi upalapte na tvitiya tunapavepi katacit parvatasyopalapte tatasca satanapavepi tarni upalapyata iti asiti ityati krahyan patatiti atipatena asitikrahanan catyutarepiti ayan pava , ‘tunavatvat iti hetu satyasataka patitatvat’ iti pratisetanunanepi kin paksiputo trnavatvahetureva satyasataka ? uta satyasataka eva ? iti na pratana praneyatvaterapi pahnyasatakatvatarsanat na tvitiya tunavatvaheto vahnirupasatyasatakatvepi apiteyatvarupasatya-satakatvatarsanat pata ityevan avatarane tatparyanaropya vikalpatusanayo sanyat svanyayavirota iti katan ? ityata aha anyayokayokavyavacetasyeti anyayokayokayo-rvyavacetasyetyarta ‘ekasatvetvayaniha nasti’ iti pratitisitavyasacyavrti-pratiyokikapavapiprayenetan iha ca anyayokavyavacetasya ayuktatvepi ayokavyavacetasya ankikarat upayan vihaya vakyartayokat na ca ayokavyavacetanki kare uktatosa iti vacyan itanin vahninatvasya satyatvena tatayokavyavacetopapate iti ata eva ‘tasnatvahninaneva’ iti nikanananiti sanprataya uktan ca varataraciye ‘ayokavyavacetanatrena avataranopapatO’ iti tata ca ayokavyavacetanatrena avataranopapatO anyayokavyavacetena avataranasya ayuktasyEva tvaya ankikarat ayuktankatikatvan iti pava 19

pk: prananalaksanawikavakyarTakOnudi saDarnyadervipaksasya sapaksatvaprasanjanan saDanapratibandya yatsahyanityasano nata itikarikanusarena anityasanajati vadisaDaneti nanvevanavisesa-sanajatisankaryan tatrapi vadisaDanapratibandya taditaraDarnena tadvatan sarvapadarTanan visesapadanasadBavat uktanca karikayan DarnenEkena kesancidavisesaprasanjanan saDanapratibandya yatsovisesasano nata iti tatraha avisesasanayan tviti sarvavisesanatrapadananiti ‘yadi Dunavatvat parvatanahanasayo agninatvavisesa tarhi dravyatvat sarvadravyana-nanityatvan syat’ ityevanavisesasanayan sarvapadarTanan kevalananityatvadi-DarnantarenEva avisesapadananaBipretan atra puna saDyaDarnavatvapadananiti Bedat ata evoktan karikayan ‘avisesaprasanjanan , sapaksatvaprasanjanan’ iti anyatsanananiti kasyacidDarnasya kincidasaDakatvadarsanan utTanabijan , tarkaparahatiraropya ityevan utTanabijan aropyan ca avisesa-sanajativadeva draswavyanityarTa vyaptyaBavaditi ‘yatra satvan tatra agninatvan’ iti vyaptyaBavadityarTa tadanaByupagana iti vyaptyanaByugana ityarTa asaDaketi ‘satvat sarvanapi agninat syat’ iti tarkasya vyaBicarena duswatvat asaDakatvanityarTa idan Dunavatvarupan saDanan taTa ca ‘Dunavatvat itihetu saDyasaDako na Bavati tarkaparahatatvat’ iti pratiseDanunanepi ‘yadi asaDakoktatarkapratibandigrastatvat idan Dunavatvan saDyasaDakan syat tarhi padarTatvat sarvanapi asaDakan syat , ityevan sarvasyapi asaDakatva-rupasaDyaDarnavatvapadanasanBavat svanyayaviroDa iti Bava 2
ck: prananalaksanatikavakyartakOnuti satarnyatervipaksasya sapaksatvaprasancanan satanapratipantya yatsahyanityasano nata itikarikanusarena anityasanacati vatisataneti nanvevanavisesa-sanacatisankaryan tatrapi vatisatanapratipantya tatitaratarnena tatvatan sarvapatartanan visesapatanasatpavat uktanca karikayan tarnenEkena kesancitavisesaprasancanan satanapratipantya yatsovisesasano nata iti tatraha avisesasanayan tviti sarvavisesanatrapatananiti ‘yati tunavatvat parvatanahanasayo akninatvavisesa tarhi travyatvat sarvatravyana-nanityatvan syat’ ityevanavisesasanayan sarvapatartanan kevalananityatvati-tarnantarenEva avisesapatananapipretan atra puna satyatarnavatvapatananiti petat ata evoktan karikayan ‘avisesaprasancanan , sapaksatvaprasancanan’ iti anyatsanananiti kasyacitarnasya kincitasatakatvatarsanan utanapican , tarkaparahatiraropya ityevan utanapican aropyan ca avisesa-sanacativateva trastavyanityarta vyaptyapavatiti ‘yatra satvan tatra akninatvan’ iti vyaptyapavatityarta tatanapyupakana iti vyaptyanapyukana ityarta asataketi ‘satvat sarvanapi akninat syat’ iti tarkasya vyapicarena tustatvat asatakatvanityarta itan tunavatvarupan satanan tata ca ‘tunavatvat itihetu satyasatako na pavati tarkaparahatatvat’ iti pratisetanunanepi ‘yati asatakoktatarkapratipantikrastatvat itan tunavatvan satyasatakan syat tarhi patartatvat sarvanapi asatakan syat , ityevan sarvasyapi asatakatva-rupasatyatarnavatvapatanasanpavat svanyayavirota iti pava 2
